question.text: The maximum number of investors per scheme of an AIF (other than an Angel Fund) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 7/8: AIF schemes are capped at 1,000 investors, with Accredited Investors NOT counted in this limit. Angel Funds are a separate regime. **The Trap:** Option A is the Companies Act 2013 private placement cap (200), unrelated to AIF scheme cap. Option B fabricates. Option D ignores the regulation. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B test the 1000 cap; XIX-C tests it with the AI-exclusion nuance — very commonly tested. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Track investor count in real time during fund-raise. If you see the headcount nearing 950, switch remaining commitments to AI-declared investors (with requisite paperwork) to preserve runway to 1000.
